blocks.text: On-demand access ka matlab hai ke aap jab chahein computing resources istemal kar sakte hain, lambe setup ka intezar kiye baghair. Yeh aise hai jaise pani chahiye to nalka khol lein, pehle kuan khodne ki zaroorat na ho.

Misal (Example): aap school project par kaam kar rahe hain aur achanak files rakhne ke liye mazeed storage chahiye. On-demand access se aap cloud provider se foran mazeed storage kiraye par le kar usi waqt istemal shuru kar sakte hain. Is se waqt aur mehnat bachti hai aur aap storage ki fikr ki bajaye apne project par dhyan dete hain.

items: On-Demand Access: zor is baat par hai ke jab bhi zaroorat ho, resources foran haasil kar ke istemal kiye ja sakein.
Elasticity: zor is baat par hai ke system asal waqt (real-time) ki demand ke mutabiq resources khud kam zyada kare, taake kaarkardagi (performance) aur kifayat (efficiency) bani rahe.

blocks.prompt: Cloud computing mein elasticity aur on-demand access mein farq bataiye (exercise short question 9).
blocks.explanation: On-demand access: user jab maange, resources foran mil jate hain aur woh unhein istemal shuru kar deta hai. Elasticity: system khud demand dekh kar resources barhata ya ghatata hai, user ko har baar maangna nahi parta; maqsad performance aur kam kharcha hai.

items: On-demand access: maangte hi resources (nalke ki misal).
Elasticity: demand ke mutabiq khud kaar kami beshi.
